pat.intro: GitLab yana buƙatar token na samun dama – irin kalmar sirri don manhajoji – don loda canje-canje, ƙirƙirar ma'ajiyoyi, buɗe ma'ajiyoyi masu zaman kansu ko ɗauko bayanai sau da yawa.
pat.step2: A ƙarƙashin "Generate token", zaɓi "Legacy token" — wannan haɗin ba ya goyon bayan sabon nau'in token "Fine-grained".
pat.step3: Tabbatar cewa an zaɓi "api" scope (haɗin da ke sama ya riga ya zaɓe shi).
pat.step5: Ƙirƙiri token ɗin. GitLab yana nuna shi sau ɗaya kawai — kwafe shi yanzu ka manna a ƙasa.
